page.overview:
Who is Denethor II?

Denethor II was the twenty-sixth and last Ruling Steward, also last overall Steward, of Gondor. He was father to War of the Ring heroes Boromir, a member of the Fellowship of the Ring, and Faramir, Captain of the Rangers of Ithilien.

Denethor was the third child and only son of Ecthelion II. A proud and noble man, the blood of Númenor ran truer in him than it had in any man of Gondor for many years. He was described as subtle and often scornful and could perceive the thoughts of men, including those that dwelled far off, similar to Faramir; but his son was oft moved to pity, whereas Denethor was filled with disdain. It was difficult to deceive him and dangerous to try.

In TA 2976, he married Finduilas of Dol Amroth, daughter of Prince Adrahil II of Dol Amroth. Together, the couple had two sons, Boromir and Faramir. A few years later, in TA 2988, Finduilas died young, leaving Denethor embittered.

He succeeded his father Ecthelion II as twenty-sixth Ruling Steward in TA 2984. During his stewardship, unfortunately, Gandalf was less welcome in Minas Tirith, and his counsels went unheeded.
